description:

handoff_summary.completed: Fixed test_three_paragraphs_three_chunks: changed from chunk_size=1000 asserting 1 chunk (spec violation) to chunk_size=20 asserting 3 chunks (matches spec AC). Replaced the removed test_three_paragraphs_three_chunks_small_size with a new test_short_paragraphs_merged_when_all_fit_in_chunk that explicitly documents the merge behavior. Finding 2 (tests/test_memory.py missing, TestIngestJson/TestIngestCsv absent) was already resolved by bead B-812641b9-test — those files and classes exist.
handoff_summary.remaining: None. All blocking findings are resolved. Parent bead B-d34d190d-review can now be retried — the test now correctly exercises the spec AC "3 paragraphs → 3 rows (each under chunk_size)" and the merge behavior is separately documented. Finding 3 (low/non-blocking: expected_files metadata in bead JSON) is a metadata-only issue that can be addressed at bead close time by the orchestrator.
handoff_summary.risks: None significant. The change is confined to test assertions — no production code was modified. memory.py syntax verified clean.
handoff_summary.next_action: Retry parent bead B-d34d190d-review. The review agent should now find that test_three_paragraphs_three_chunks correctly asserts 3 chunks matching the spec AC, and that test_memory.py contains TestIngestJson and TestIngestCsv as required.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None. Only tests/test_ingest_chunking.py was modified; no active beads claim this file.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Resolved the spec ambiguity by keeping the merge-up-to-chunk-size implementation (explicitly described in the spec's .txt strategy) and fixing the test to use chunk_size=20, which satisfies the spec AC ("each paragraph is under chunk_size" = 14-16 chars < 20) while preventing merging (any two together = 30+ chars > 20). Added a complementary test documenting the merge behavior.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: test_ingest_chunking.py now has two tests covering both behaviors: test_three_paragraphs_three_chunks (spec AC: 3 rows when paragraphs can't merge) and test_short_paragraphs_merged_when_all_fit_in_chunk (merge behavior when all paragraphs fit in chunk_size). tests/test_memory.py's TestIngestTxt.test_three_paragraphs_produce_three_rows independently validates the same AC at the DB-integration level.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Finding 3 (bead metadata: expected_files list missing test_memory.py and test_ingest_json_csv.py) is a takt metadata issue, not a code issue. The orchestrator should update the bead JSON accordingly.

conflict_risks: None. Only tests/test_ingest_chunking.py was modified; no active beads claim this file.
